page0.text:
...
...We have to accept his offer.
Even if he is an enemy, his argument is correct.
Tohsaka and I alone can't beat Caster.
But there should be some hope if we have Lancer's help.
However...

page1.text:
"...All right. I'll believe your argument.
But under one condition. I'll accept your help in defeating Caster, and we'll trust you.
But..."

page2.text:
"But what? You want me to tell you who my Master is?"
"No. Even if we're cooperating, stay away from Tohsaka."

page3.text:
The air freezes.
Lancer becomes speechless as if he was completely caught off guard.

page4.text:
"Hah, I see, I see! Of course, that's way more important than my Master right, kid!?"
He starts laughing as if it's the funniest thing he's heard.

page5.text:
"What, is that bad? Just letting you know, but I won't let you have Tohsaka."
"Of course not. It's not bad. In fact, I see you in a whole new light.
Wow, that's great, young lady. This kid is head over heels over you!"

page6.text:
"Guh! W-W-W-What are you saying, we're not like that! Um... Yes, we're just cooperating...!"
"Are you sure about that?"

page7.text:
"Guh...! You get on my nerves. What's with that know-it-all face...!?
Come on, say something, Shirou. Tell him we're just cooperating!"

page9.text:
"Hey, say something, idiot...!
T-This is as if we, um, actually like each other..."

page10.text:
"Hey, it's not 'as if.' You guys are already in love with each other. It's obvious even to me, though you're both covering it up. Man, she'll be quite a handful, boy."
Lancer makes a sympathetic gesture.

page11.text:
"...Well. I already know that Tohsaka is a handful."
I reply with a sour look to let him know that there's no problem.

page12.text:
"Wha—"
"Oh, how dependable. Then I shall be mindful when I interact with her.
But well, she's fun to tease, so I'll have fun on the way. You don't mind this much, right?"

page13.text:
"...All right. Let's go with that. We'll get your help until we defeat Caster."
"Then it's decided. Well, let's shake hands."

page14.text:
Lancer comes up to me unarmed and shakes my right hand that I awkwardly put out.
There are worrying factors, but we were able to obtain a reliable ally.
All that's left is...
